name: Przychodnia Weterynaryjna Salamandra
short_description: Clinic with in-house lab, X-ray and ultrasound; also treats birds, reptiles and small mammals.
short_description_local: Lecznica z laboratorium, RTG i USG; leczy też ptaki, gady i małe ssaki.
description: Veterinary practice opened in September 2014, where ten vets treat dogs and cats as well as fur-bearing animals, birds, reptiles and wildlife. It has an operating theatre, a hospital room with an isolation unit, an in-house lab for blood, urine and stool tests, X-ray and ultrasound. It issues pet passports, runs a hotel for small mammals, and visits can be booked online.
description_local: Przychodnia działa od września 2014 roku; dziesięciu lekarzy leczy psy i koty, a także zwierzęta futerkowe, ptaki, gady i zwierzęta dzikie. Na miejscu jest sala operacyjna, sala szpitalna z izolatką, laboratorium (krew, mocz, kał), RTG i USG. Przychodnia wystawia paszporty, prowadzi hotel dla małych ssaków, a wizytę można zarezerwować online.

name: Klinika Weterynaryjna Arka
short_description: Clinic since 1993 with Cat Friendly Clinic Gold status, CT and a hospital for dogs and cats.
short_description_local: Klinika od 1993 r. ze statusem Cat Friendly Clinic (Gold), tomografem i szpitalem.
description: Clinic founded in 1993 that announces 24/7 emergency duty and lists daytime visiting hours on its site. It covers dentistry, dermatology, cardiology, ophthalmology, oncology, orthopaedics and surgery, with CT, ultrasound, X-ray, endoscopy and lab tests, and keeps separate hospital wards for dogs and cats. Cats wait in their own corner and are seen in rooms without dog smells; the clinic holds Cat Friendly Clinic Gold status, accepts cards and takes online bookings.

description: Clinic on Centralna Street offering surgery and orthopaedics, internal-medicine and surgical consultations, and imaging with X-ray, ultrasound, ECG, heart echo and endoscopy. name: Przychodnia Weterynaryjna Retina
short_description: Eye care for dogs and cats: cataract and glaucoma surgery, plus CT and cardiology.
short_description_local: Okulistyka psów i kotów: operacje zaćmy i jaskry, a do tego tomografia i kardiologia.
description: Practice for dogs and cats led by a veterinary ophthalmologist, with a second site on Zakopiańska Street. It performs cataract surgery by phacoemulsification, glaucoma surgery and ECVO hereditary eye examinations, alongside cardiology, dentistry, oncology, neurology, reproduction and orthopaedics (TPLO, TTA). Diagnostics include CT, digital X-ray, endoscopy, ultrasound and blood tests, and card payment is accepted.
description_local: Przychodnia dla psów i kotów prowadzona przez lekarza okulistę weterynaryjnego, z drugą placówką przy ul. Zakopiańskiej. Wykonuje operacje zaćmy metodą fakoemulsyfikacji, zabiegi przeciwjaskrowe i badania chorób dziedzicznych oczu wg ECVO, a także kardiologię, stomatologię, onkologię, neurologię, rozród i ortopedię (TPLO, TTA). Diagnostyka obejmuje tomografię, cyfrowe RTG, endoskopię, USG i badania krwi; można płacić kartą.

description: Family practice for dogs and cats, run as a clinic since 2016 by vet Rafał Niedziółka and open every day until midnight. Vets also make home visits, issue EU pet passports on the spot, and some visits are possible in Ukrainian and Russian; client parking is on site.
